asset_action.description: Allows the model to run an asset action block.
schema: Or: {"action":"project_search","attachment":"attached folder name or selector id","path":".","query":"literal text","offset":0,"limit":100}
Other asset action schemas come from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
rules: Project actions read a local folder linked by the user. attachment selects the project and may be the visible folder name shown in PROJECT_REVIEW or its ASSET_ACTION selector id; omit it when exactly one folder is attached. attachment is metadata, never a file-path root. path may be relative to the selected folder (".", "src") or use the visible folder root ("jin_core/src"); never use an absolute filesystem path.

project_tree lists file/folder paths, not file contents. depth 1 lists direct children; depth 1..20 is allowed (default 3). Returned paths are always rooted at the visible attached-folder name, e.g. jin_core/docs/ and jin_core/docs/file.md.

project_search searches file contents, not filenames. query is literal text, case-insensitive, not regex. Each result is folder-rooted-path:line_number:source_text; line numbers start at 1. Multiple matching lines in one file count as multiple results.

offset is the number of results to skip (default 0), not a line number or scan position. limit is the maximum number of returned paths or matching lines (default 100, allowed 1..200). For a next page, use the returned offset and keep the other inputs unchanged. A scan stop means unsearched files may remain: use smaller subfolders with offset 0. A larger limit or offset does not extend the scan.

Tree/search do not load source files. To inspect a match, copy the returned folder-rooted path into ATTACH_FILE, optionally with #Lstart-Lend. Use the same path with DETACH_FILE. Search reads UTF-8 text files up to 1 MiB; tree/search skip generated/dependency folders and symlinks. Skipped files/folders are not skipped matches.
During project review only user-pinned DELAYED reports and their facts are context. Ordinary memory save/update actions remain available. Keep folder links attached unless the user asks to detach.
For other ASSET_ACTION operations, derive concrete schema from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
